blocks.text: Models are useful because they give a structured way to think about a problem. They take complicated information and make it easier to work with. This is especially important in decision making, where models help us consider different outcomes before making a choice.

Example: When a farmer use a model to decide the best time to plant crops. By studying weather patterns and soil conditions, the model helps the farmer predict the right planting time, which increases the chances of a good harvest.
